summary.en: The site and content system for a DSE tutoring team — bilingual copy, class photography, teacher and course pages, and an edit path a non-developer can run.
summary.zh-Hant: DSE 補習團隊的網站與內容系統——雙語文案、課堂相片、導師與課程頁，以及非技術同事也操作得來的編輯流程。

what.en: A public site for a Hong Kong DSE tutoring team: who teaches, what each class covers, and how to get in touch. Behind it sits a content system the team updates itself.
what.zh-Hant: 香港 DSE 補習團隊的對外網站：誰任教、每堂課教甚麼、怎樣聯絡。背後是一套由團隊自己更新的內容系統。

why.en: Parents and students choose a tutor on trust. The site has to carry that trust on real class photography, and the team should not have to wait on a developer every time a class changes.
why.zh-Hant: 家長與學生選補習，靠的是信任。網站要用真實的課堂相片承住這份信任，而團隊每次改課程都不應該等開發者。

highlights.en: A design system built to stay consistent and reusable, and to follow the brand's philosophy rather than a template's.
highlights.zh-Hant: 設計系統維持一致、可重用，並跟隨品牌理念，而不是套用範本。

highlights.en: Content and components link to one another as a graph, which makes dependencies easier to manage.
highlights.zh-Hant: 內容與元件以圖譜互相連結，依賴關係因此更易管理。

highlights.en: Milestone pages are generated from available sources and fact-checked automatically.
highlights.zh-Hant: 里程碑頁面按現有來源自動生成，並自動核查事實。

text.en: Dark editorial layout built to survive real class photos rather than placeholders
text.zh-Hant: 深色編輯式版面，為真實課堂相片而設，而非佔位圖

summary.en: A menu-bar app that keeps a Mac awake with the lid closed, so a long build or a deploy does not die when you walk away.
summary.zh-Hant: 選單列小工具：合上蓋仍讓 Mac 保持清醒，長時間編譯或部署不會因為你離開而中斷。

what.en: A macOS menu-bar app with a timer, a forever mode, a memory panel and quiet cleanup. It holds the machine awake with the lid shut.
what.zh-Hant: macOS 選單列小工具：計時器、永久模式、記憶體面板，以及安靜的清理。合上蓋也讓機器保持清醒。

why.en: Long builds and deploys fail when the Mac sleeps, and closing the lid is how a laptop is normally carried. It should not be how work gets killed.
why.zh-Hant: Mac 一睡，長時間的編譯與部署就斷；而合上蓋本來就是攜帶筆記簿的常態，不應該成為工作中斷的原因。

challenge.en: Shipping a menu-bar utility that a stranger can actually install: a versioned release, a Homebrew cask, and a landing page that explains it in one screen.
challenge.zh-Hant: 把選單列小工具做到陌生人真的裝得起來：有版本號的發佈、Homebrew cask，以及一屏就講清楚的產品頁。

highlights.en: 51 commits, tagged through v1.7.0.
highlights.zh-Hant: 51 個 commit，版本標籤至 v1.7.0。

highlights.en: Installable through a Homebrew cask.
highlights.zh-Hant: 可經 Homebrew cask 安裝。

highlights.en: Its own landing page, with the install line and a mascot.
highlights.zh-Hant: 有自己的產品頁，附安裝指令與吉祥物。

text.en: 51 commits, tagged through v1.7.0, installable via Homebrew cask
text.zh-Hant: 51 個 commit，版本標籤至 v1.7.0，可經 Homebrew cask 安裝

text.en: Public repository and separate Homebrew tap
text.zh-Hant: 公開倉庫，另設 Homebrew tap

summary.en: A verification plugin for AI agents: fact, logic and tool-use checks that run outside the model, through hooks the agent cannot skip.
summary.zh-Hant: AI Agent 的驗證外掛：事實、邏輯與工具使用的核查在模型之外進行，透過 Agent 跳不過的 hook 執行。

what.en: A plugin that puts a fixed sequence of checks around an agent's answer — a dedup gate, pre-answer checks, and post-answer audit stages drawing on SIFT, IFCN, CoVe, FIRE and FABLE.
what.zh-Hant: 在 Agent 的回答前後套上固定核查序列的外掛——去重閘、答前核查，以及取材自 SIFT、IFCN、CoVe、FIRE、FABLE 的答後審核階段。

why.en: Making a model more capable does not make it more honest. The check has to live outside the thing being checked.
why.zh-Hant: 把模型做得更強，不會令它更誠實。核查必須住在被核查的東西之外。

challenge.en: Enforcing the sequence from outside: a skipped check has to surface as a failure, not as silence.
challenge.zh-Hant: 從外部強制執行整個序列：跳過的核查必須顯示為失敗，而不是靜靜地沒有發生。

highlights.en: Each phase does one job; information flows down and never back up.
highlights.zh-Hant: 每個階段只做一件事；資訊只向下流，不回頭。

highlights.en: Enforcement is external, through hooks the agent cannot opt out of.
highlights.zh-Hant: 強制執行在外部，透過 Agent 無法退出的 hook。

highlights.en: Public documentation page and repository.
highlights.zh-Hant: 公開的說明頁與倉庫。

text.zh-Hant: 說明文件在 GitHub Pages 上線

summary.en: A private control plane for personal agents — input, memory, execution, communication, outreach and evolving — running locally, never publicly.
summary.zh-Hant: 個人 Agent 的私有控制面——輸入、記憶、執行、通訊、對外接觸與演化——只在本地運行，不對外公開。

what.en: Six layers behind one local API: activity input, a memory layer with a propose → inbox → drain path, a task, run and approval state machine, communication channels, outreach scans, and a set of deterministic detectors. The product repository holds no personal data.
what.zh-Hant: 六層架構，共用一個本地 API：活動輸入、以「提案 → 收件箱 → 處理」運作的記憶層、任務／執行／審批狀態機、通訊頻道、對外接觸掃描，以及一組確定性的偵測器。產品倉庫不存放個人資料。

why.en: An agent that acts on your behalf needs somewhere to remember, decide and be audited. A chat window is not that place, and a cloud service holding your context is the wrong default.
why.zh-Hant: 替你辦事的 Agent，需要一個能記住、能決定、能被審計的地方。聊天視窗不是那個地方，而把你的上下文交給雲端服務，是不該預設的選擇。

challenge.en: Keeping every agent action auditable while the system stays usable: sending, payment, approvals, privacy and backup are deliberately not things the agent can change by itself.
challenge.zh-Hant: 在系統仍然好用的前提下，令每個 Agent 動作都可審計：發送、付款、審批、私隱與備份，刻意不讓 Agent 自行改動。

highlights.en: 669 contract tests green, typecheck clean (2026-11-05).
highlights.zh-Hant: 669 個契約測試全綠，typecheck 乾淨（2026-11-05）。

highlights.en: Local by default, reachable over Tailscale.
highlights.zh-Hant: 預設本地，經 Tailscale 存取。

highlights.en: Product code and personal data kept in separate repositories.
highlights.zh-Hant: 產品程式與個人資料分開兩個倉庫。

text.en: 669 contract tests green; `npm run typecheck` clean
text.zh-Hant: 669 個契約測試全綠；`npm run typecheck` 乾淨

text.en: Six layers; product repo contains no personal data
text.zh-Hant: 六層架構；產品倉庫不含個人資料

summary.en: Narrated, slide-faithful lectures for an algorithms course: every element appears at the moment the narration explains it, and stays on screen.
summary.zh-Hant: 演算法課程的旁白講課，與課件逐格對齊：每個元素都在旁白講到它的那一刻出現，然後留在畫面上。

what.en: Eleven narrated lectures for COMP2119 Introduction to Algorithms, built as animated slides that keep pace with the voice, with click-through tools for recursion trees, sorting and graph traversal.
what.zh-Hant: COMP2119《演算法導論》的十一講旁白課，以跟得上聲音的動畫課件呈現，並有可逐步點開的遞迴樹、排序與圖走訪工具。

why.en: A recorded lecture is a video you cannot step through; slides alone do not explain themselves. This keeps both: hands-free autoplay, or step through it yourself.
why.zh-Hant: 錄影課是你沒法逐步拆開的影片；單看課件又不會自己解釋。這個做法兩者都保留：可以免手動自動播放，也可以自己逐步走。

challenge.en: Timing every element to the narration so nothing appears before it is explained, across 596 slides.
challenge.zh-Hant: 在 596 張課件之中，把每個元素的時間對準旁白，令任何東西都不會在講解之前出現。

highlights.en: 11 lectures, 596 slides.
Six click-through step tools, including recursion trees and graph traversal.
highlights.zh-Hant: 六個可逐步點開的工具，包括遞迴樹與圖走訪。

highlights.en: Contrast lifted to WCAG AA in both themes.
highlights.zh-Hant: 深淺兩種主題的對比度都提升至 WCAG AA。

summary.en: A speaking practice room for HKDSE English Paper 4: a pre-recorded examiner, a live voice model as the other candidate, and a report that quotes what you actually said.
summary.zh-Hant: HKDSE 英文 Paper 4 的口試練習室：預錄考官、以即時語音模型扮演另一位考生，以及引用你原話的報告。

what.en: A live voice room for Paper 4 group discussion practice. The examiner's turns are pre-recorded so the rules do not drift; the other candidate is generated live.
what.zh-Hant: 用於 Paper 4 小組討論練習的即時語音房間。考官的話語預先錄好，規則不會漂移；另一位考生即時生成。

why.en: Paper 4 is a group discussion. Practising alone does not reproduce the interruption, the turn cap, or the need to respond to another person.
why.zh-Hant: Paper 4 是小組討論。自己一個人練，重現不了被打斷、時限，以及要回應另一個人的壓力。

challenge.en: Real-time audio with interruption handling, relayed server-side so the browser needs no VPN.
challenge.zh-Hant: 具備打斷處理的即時語音，經伺服器轉發，瀏覽器不用 VPN。

highlights.en: 120-second turn cap with interruption handling — practice rules, not exam rules.
highlights.zh-Hant: 每輪 120 秒上限並處理打斷——是練習規則，不是考試規則。

highlights.en: Reports anchored to the candidate's own sentences, not a generic score.
highlights.zh-Hant: 報告扣住考生自己的句子，而不是一個通用分數。

highlights.en: Server-side relay, so no VPN is needed.
highlights.zh-Hant: 伺服器端轉發，不需要 VPN。

text.en: Live at p4.onezion.top with an access code
text.zh-Hant: 在 p4.onezion.top 上線，需存取碼

summary.en: An installable PWA course engine for Shanghainese, where a lesson only ships from sourced material and the engine refuses to invent answers.
summary.zh-Hant: 可安裝的上海話課程 PWA：課程只會從有出處的材料出貨，引擎拒絕自行編答案。

what.en: A Duolingo-shaped course engine for a dialect with almost no course material, with a content pipeline that flags what it cannot verify.
what.zh-Hant: 為幾乎沒有教材的方言而做的 Duolingo 式課程引擎，內容管線會標明它無法核實的部分。

why.en: The scarce thing is not the app; it is trustworthy content for a language that is mostly spoken and rarely written down.
why.zh-Hant: 稀缺的不是應用程式，而是一門以口語為主、很少寫下來的語言的可靠內容。

challenge.en: Building a pipeline that marks what it cannot source, instead of filling the gap with plausible text.
challenge.zh-Hant: 建一條會標示「找不到出處」的管線，而不是用看起來合理的文字填滿空隙。

highlights.en: 35,501 lines across 13 commits, with 11 test files.
highlights.zh-Hant: 35,501 行、13 個 commit、11 個測試檔。

highlights.en: Same engine across five courses; four are deliberately shown as unopened.
highlights.zh-Hant: 同一引擎支援五個課程；其中四個刻意顯示為未開啟。

highlights.en: Local build, not published — the content is not cleared for public use yet.
highlights.zh-Hant: 本地建置，未公開發佈——內容尚未取得公開授權。

text.zh-Hant: 35,501 行 · 13 個 commit · 11 個測試檔

summary.en: One loopback endpoint that speaks both the Anthropic and OpenAI protocols and routes by model prefix, so one CLI can use several vendors.
summary.zh-Hant: 一個本機迴環端點，同時講 Anthropic 與 OpenAI 兩種協定，並按模型前綴路由，令一個 CLI 可以用多間廠商的模型。

what.en: A local gateway that accepts requests in either protocol, routes them by model prefix, and keeps streaming and tool calls working across vendors.
what.zh-Hant: 本地閘道：接受兩種協定的請求，按模型前綴路由，並令串流與工具呼叫跨廠商仍然可用。

why.en: Agent CLIs each speak one protocol, while the models worth using are spread across vendors. A translator at the loopback is cheaper than forking every CLI.
why.zh-Hant: 每個 Agent CLI 只講一種協定，而值得用的模型散落在不同廠商。在迴環位做一個翻譯層，比為每個 CLI 開分支便宜。

challenge.en: Keeping both protocols faithful enough that streaming, tool calls and errors survive the translation.
challenge.zh-Hant: 令兩種協定都忠實到串流、工具呼叫與錯誤都能安然渡過翻譯。

highlights.en: 13.7k lines across 16 test modules.
highlights.zh-Hant: 13.7k 行，16 個測試模組。

highlights.en: Routes by model prefix, one process per machine.
highlights.zh-Hant: 按模型前綴路由，每部機器一個程序。

highlights.en: Local only; no vendor traffic passes through a third party.
highlights.zh-Hant: 只在本地；廠商流量不經第三方。

summary.en: WeChat Pay and Alipay exports into SQLite — de-duplicated, categorised, with monthly reports built from real statements.
summary.zh-Hant: 把微信支付與支付寶的匯出檔匯入 SQLite——去重、分類，並用真實帳單生成每月報告。

what.en: An importer that reads both apps' export formats into one local database, then produces categorised monthly reports.
what.zh-Hant: 一個匯入器：讀取兩個應用程式的匯出格式，寫入同一個本地資料庫，再生成分類的每月報告。

why.en: Spending records live in two apps that do not talk to each other, in two export formats. A local database answers questions neither app will.
why.zh-Hant: 消費紀錄住在兩個互不相通的應用程式、兩種匯出格式裏。一個本地資料庫能回答兩邊都答不出的問題。

challenge.en: De-duplicating overlapping exports without dropping legitimate same-day, same-amount transactions.
challenge.zh-Hant: 在重疊的匯出檔之間去重，同時不能誤刪同一天、同一金額的真實交易。

highlights.en: Tested against real WeChat Pay and Alipay exports, not sample rows.
highlights.zh-Hant: 以真實的微信支付與支付寶匯出檔測試，不是範例資料。

highlights.en: Runs entirely locally.
highlights.zh-Hant: 完全在本地運行。

text.en: pytest against real WeChat Pay + Alipay exports
text.zh-Hant: 以真實微信支付與支付寶匯出檔跑 pytest

summary.en: A KOReader sync plugin: OAuth2 device-code authentication, the Microsoft Graph API, and bidirectional sync.
summary.zh-Hant: KOReader 同步外掛：OAuth2 裝置碼認證、Microsoft Graph API，以及雙向同步。

what.en: A Lua plugin that adds OneDrive as a sync target inside KOReader, signed in with the OAuth2 device-code flow.
what.zh-Hant: 以 Lua 寫成的外掛，在 KOReader 內加入 OneDrive 作為同步目標，用 OAuth2 裝置碼流程登入。

why.en: KOReader had no OneDrive option. The protocol had to be understood from zero before anything could ship.
why.zh-Hant: KOReader 本來沒有 OneDrive 選項。要先把協定由零理解清楚，才談得上交付。

challenge.en: Implementing device-code OAuth and the Graph API calls in Lua, inside KOReader's plugin model.
challenge.zh-Hant: 在 KOReader 的外掛模型裏，用 Lua 實作裝置碼 OAuth 與 Graph API 呼叫。

highlights.en: OAuth2 device-code authentication, so no browser is needed on the device.
highlights.zh-Hant: OAuth2 裝置碼認證，裝置上不需要瀏覽器。

highlights.en: Bidirectional sync engine against Microsoft Graph.
highlights.zh-Hant: 對接 Microsoft Graph 的雙向同步引擎。

highlights.en: Public repository.
highlights.zh-Hant: 公開倉庫。

text.zh-Hant: 公開的 Lua 外掛倉庫，建立於 2026-07

summary.en: A CBT-based game for getting through a breakup: thirty days, ten minutes a day, bilingual.
summary.zh-Hant: 以認知行為治療為基礎的療癒遊戲：三十天、每天十分鐘、雙語。

what.en: An interactive daily programme built on cognitive behavioural therapy, written in English and Chinese.
what.zh-Hant: 以認知行為治療建成的每日互動課程，中英雙語。

why.en: The hard part of a breakup is not information; it is doing one small thing every day.
why.zh-Hant: 分手最難的不是資訊，而是每天真的做一件小事。

challenge.en: Turning a therapy structure into daily play without making it feel like homework or a quiz.
challenge.zh-Hant: 把治療結構變成每日遊玩，又不至於像功課或測驗。

highlights.en: Thirty days, ten minutes a day.
highlights.zh-Hant: 三十天，每天十分鐘。

highlights.en: Bilingual throughout.
highlights.zh-Hant: 全程雙語。

highlights.en: Live on GitHub Pages.
highlights.zh-Hant: 在 GitHub Pages 上線。

summary.en: Fact-checked research pages on psychology, relationships and everyday curiosity — written for people outside the field.
summary.zh-Hant: 關於心理學、親密關係與日常好奇心的查證研究頁——寫給不在這個領域的人。

what.en: A set of long-form pages that take one question each — attachment, conflict styles, self-love versus approval — and follow it through the research rather than the discourse.
what.zh-Hant: 一組長文頁面，每頁處理一個問題——依附、衝突風格、自愛與社會肯定——順著研究走，而不是順著流行說法走。

why.en: Research that changes how you live is usually locked in papers, or flattened into claims with no source.
why.zh-Hant: 能改變生活的東西，通常鎖在論文裏；流傳出來的，又常被壓成沒有出處的斷言。

challenge.en: Keeping every claim traceable to a study while writing for a reader who will not open the PDF.
challenge.zh-Hant: 在寫給不會去開 PDF 的讀者的同時，令每個說法都追得回一項研究。

highlights.en: Each page ends with its references.
highlights.zh-Hant: 每頁結尾都附參考文獻。

highlights.en: Written in Chinese and English.
highlights.zh-Hant: 中英雙語。

highlights.en: Published as a public collection.
highlights.zh-Hant: 以公開合集形式發佈。

text.en: Public repository and reference list on every page
text.zh-Hant: 公開倉庫，每頁附參考文獻
